=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:142-147 (enforced at 730-733) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The narrowed PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE refuses "could not / cannot / can't / unable to" only before verify/check/confirm, so evidence such as "passed: 0 callers, but the grep could not run" is accepted.
  WHY: validate_result returns no error, so run_apply can stage deletion of the script and its registry entry for a preflight that never ran. All four reviewers rated this MAJOR (mapped to high).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1276-1284 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the questions changed, asked_at is sampled with _iso(_now()) after the issue-body PATCH or POST in run_decisions. A trusted answer posted before that sample has created_at before asked_at, and trusted_answers drops it.
  WHY: The saved comment count then stops later collects from re-reading the answer, so it can be lost. This is a narrow race window. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT with confidence 1 and called it unreachable. The other three rated it NIT with confidence 3-4.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1276-1324 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the audit re-asks the same questions, the path is in `opened`, so the tail loop at 1317-1324 skips it. The saved comment count is not reset to -1.
  WHY: The next collect sees an unchanged count and skips the comments, so an answer already collected is not re-read and the owner may have to answer again.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py is_maintenance_pr() (lines 384-404), author check at lines 401-402
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Lines 401-402 call trusted(pr), which accepts any OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR author_association, and nothing compares the author login with the GH_PAT identity. The recorded-number alternative at lines 403-404 is implemented. A same-repository lookalike PR from a trusted-association user can still block the gate. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR; the other three rated it NIT and called it an acceptable or documented substitute.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:142-145 (removal validation at 732) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The validator accepts evidence such as "passed: 0 callers; the workflow grep could not run", because "could not" is rejected only before verify, check or confirm.
  WHY: validate_result accepts the removal even though the preflight did not run, and the apply path can commit the script deletion.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1283-1284, 1317-1324 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a trusted answer is collected but the audit asks the same question again, opened[path] is set and the answer-preservation loop skips it, while the saved comment count already includes the answer.
  WHY: The next collect skips the unchanged comment count, so the audit does not receive the answer and the user must answer again.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1279, 1283 (trusted_answers 512-521) | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: For changed questions, asked_at is sampled after the issue-body PATCH, so an answer posted before _now() is sampled falls before the saved cutoff.
  WHY: The next collect rejects the answer as older than asked_at and saves the updated comment count, so later collects skip it and the answer is lost.
- TASK_GAP (severity=high, confidence=5):
  Requirement: "The PR author is the GH_PAT identity (or the PR number matches the `maintenance_pr` saved in the trusted status-issue state marker)."
  Expected change site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py, is_maintenance_pr
  Evidence of absence: The function accepts any PR whose author_association passes trusted(pr) and does not compare the author login with the GH_PAT identity. The recorded-number alternative is implemented, but a same-repository OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR with a matching branch can still block the gate.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:142-147 (enforced at 732-733) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run narrowed the failure-word check to the verdict position plus could-not/cannot/can't/unable-to before verify, check or confirm. "passed: 0 callers, but the workflow grep could not run" and "could not execute" match none of the three alternatives.
  WHY: validate_result returns no error, so finish_audit accepts the result and run_apply stages deletion for a preflight that never executed. This contradicts the design comment at lines 140-141.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:1283 (run_decisions, the `else _iso(_now())` branch) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the questions changed, asked_at is sampled after the issue-body PATCH at line 1279 and the POST at line 1281. run_collect samples collected_at before its reads at lines 537-539, and this site inverts that ordering.
  WHY: A trusted answer posted before _now() executes has created_at before asked_at, so trusted_answers (line 520) drops it, and it is never re-read once the count is re-saved.
- TASK_GAP (severity=low, confidence=4):
  Requirement: "Count a PR as a maintenance PR only if its provenance can be checked automatically: head.repo.full_name equals the repository, head.ref matches the exact pattern branch_name() produces (^ai/plan-autopilot-[0-9]{8}-[0-9a-f]{7}(-[23])?$), and the PR author is the GH_PAT identity (or the PR number matches the maintenance_pr saved in the trusted status-issue state marker)."
  Expected change site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py, is_maintenance_pr() (lines 384-404), author check at lines 401-402
  Evidence of absence: Lines 401-402 call trusted(pr), which at line 327-328 checks only author_association. Nothing compares the author login with the GH_PAT identity. The repo/name checks and the recorded maintenance_pr fallback are implemented, so the original fork-PR attack is fixed. The reviewer rated the residual gap below the pass-1 MAJOR.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/plan_autopilot.py line 145; extend the verb group with run, execute and complete, and add alternatives for "not verified", "not checked", "not confirmed" and "unverified". HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- Editor note: tests/test_plan_autopilot.py:162-174 and 201-210 carry duplicate fork and misnamed-branch coverage. It is redundant, not a defect, and needs no action.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
